content.text:
I assumed you meant the Tasks tab's list in the right sidebar. When I moved the previous tasks into it, I dropped the old history list's draw-only-what's-in-view rule. If you meant a different list, tell me which. I added a new section, `.claude/reference/ui/components/right-sidebar/tasks/index.md#virtualized`; `piton check` reports no problems and `piton build` wrote 82 files.

- **Only visible rows are drawn:** the list draws the rows in view plus a few either side. Opening, scrolling, resizing, filtering and new tasks should cost the same with ten thousand tasks as with ten.
- **Fixed row height:** every row is 28px, group headings and expanded chain steps included. So any row's position, and the scrollbar's size and place, come from row counts alone.
- **Light data:** a row's mode, status, first line and time are read from its history record once and kept. A task's full output is only read when you open it.
- **Updates:** running rows update their spinner and time in place.
- **Jumping:** scrolling to a row, such as when the tab opens or a filter changes, goes straight there without drawing the rows in between.
- **State kept:** a row scrolled out and back keeps its expanded chain, selection and highlight.

**Anchors the code should follow:** `TasksTabScope` `#virtualized`, with `#rows` and `#description`.
